slot.brief: Set operations: given cardinalities of A, B and their intersection/union, find cardinality of a combination using Venn-type identities

stem: If $|A|=26$, $|B|=21$ and $|A\cup B|=35$, find $|(A\cup B)\setminus(A\cap B)|$.
working:
$|A\cap B|=26+21-35=12$. Thus $|(A\cup B)\setminus(A\cap B)|=35-12=23$.

Independent check: |A∩B| = 26 + 21 − 35 = 12. Thus |(A∪B)\(A∩B)| = 35 − 12 = 23.
solution:
By inclusion-exclusion, $|A\cap B|=|A|+|B|-|A\cup B|=26+21-35=12$. Hence
$$|(A\cup B)\setminus(A\cap B)|=35-12=23.$$
